# test_acf {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_acf(data, h; alpha=0.05)
```
Perform the asymptotic two-sided test for serial dependence at lag `h` based on the classical autocorrelation function (ACF) and return an [`ACFTestResult`](ACFTestResult.qmd) with the test statistic, the asymptotic critical value, the p-value, and the reject decision.
 
  * `data`: the time series.
  * `h::Int`: lag.
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.


:::
